profile.headline: Staff Ai Software Engineer at ServiceNow
profile.summary:
Staff Ai Software Engineer at ServiceNow working to build autonomous Ai systems. Unlike a traditional engineering team, I work in a lab where we explore, innovate and productize bleeding edge research related to gen-ai.

Previously I was a Lead backend software engineer at Salesforce where I owned and the JDK program across the company. 

Like a Swiss Army knife, I am well versed in Ci/Cd pipelines, build systems, software architecture, containerization, security, language models and many other aspects of software systems. I am enthusiastic about technology and I bring passion into the projects I work on.

MS and BS in computer science from Cal Poly SLO and publications on semantic search.

View Resume:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SMAA8aFMUe_l_s0bwP8kzJRZAkAchXMQ/view?usp=sharing

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Working in Platform Labs working on bleeding edge Agentic Ai automation solutions. We build everything from ground up, move fast and deliver amazing products to market.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineering / Data Science
positions.description:
Worked on an autonomous robot for facility and retail applications. Implemented the high level navigation software to direct the robot through intricate floor layouts which included an elegant user interface, RESTful services, and shortest path algorithms such as A*. 

Implemented the hardware driver that interfaced with the high level navigation controller over the networking using RESTful server. Driver code interfaced with IMU, LIDAR, and 3D camera using the Robotic Operating System framework. 

Made contributions in training a CNN by using object detection techniques and dramatically improved manual training data inspections by developing a user friendly website.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked on a Raspberry Pi Realtime Operating System. Produced application software to promote affordable Internet of Things technology.
o	Wrote software to demonstrate the processor and graphics operation.
o	Experimented and automated the partitioning of application code to optimize code storage between main CPU and less expensive storage, such as Flash.

positions.title: Programming Tutor
positions.description: Tutored students in C and Java Programming
